Definition: a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece
BiblicalUsage: Machbereth is the coupling, the seam where the curtains of the tabernacle joined. Exodus 26:4 commands the loops of blue on the edge of the curtain in the coupling, and Exodus 36:12 says the loops held one curtain to another when it was made.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that God cares about the joins: the holy place held together because every loop caught its fellow.
